title: arnica angustifolia subsp. alpina
intro: Arnica angustifolia subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Arnica, is a plant species within the sunflower family, characterized by its narrow leaves and small yellow flowers. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for wounds, bruises, and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Arnica include analgesic, anti-edematous, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Arnica include sesquiterpene lactones, such as alpine arnica acid, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
